summary.name: SwitchHosts
summary.one_liner: SwitchHosts is a free, open-source app for managing and switching between multiple hosts file configurations.
use_cases: switch between different hosts file setups
load hosts rules from a remote source
quickly enable or disable hosts entries
import and export hosts rule sets
summary.what_it_does: SwitchHosts manages and switches between multiple hosts file schemes (profiles). It supports selecting multiple schemes at once, syntax highlighting, and toggling entries on or off by clicking line numbers. Hosts schemes can be local or remote, and can be imported and exported. A system menu bar item allows quick switching between schemes.
notable: Remote hosts schemes can be loaded from a URL
Quick switching from the system status/menu bar
caveats: Alternative download sites are listed (Baidu Yun, Softpedia)
